name: Littleroot Area
description: The lush southern start of Hoenn, spanning Littleroot Town, Oldale, and the routes around Petalburg City and its woods.

name: Rustboro Area
description: The industrial northwest around Rustboro City, Petalburg Woods, Rusturf Tunnel, and the routes toward the sea.

name: Dewford Area
description: The rugged southern island of Dewford Town, home to Granite Cave and the surrounding open seas.

name: Mauville Area
description: The central crossroads around Mauville City and Slateport, including the cycling road, the seaside Route 110, and New Mauville.

name: Lavaridge Area
description: The volcanic highlands around Lavaridge Town, encompassing Mt. Chimney, the Fiery Path, and the Jagged Pass.

name: Fortree Area
description: The verdant tree-top region around Fortree City, the Weather Institute, and the long routes east toward the coast.

name: Mossdeep Area
description: The eastern sea around Mossdeep City and Shoal Cave, a scattering of islands ringed by deep water.

name: Sootopolis Area
description: The remote crater city of Sootopolis, the Cave of Origin, the towering Sky Pillar, and the waters of Ever Grande.
